UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive buttons, switches, filters, cards, and modals contain exact data-testid attributes.
Never hardcode fake or artificial online partner counts; maintain honest empty states.
Ensure total horizontal padding fits narrow devices down to 320px width without horizontal scrolling or truncation.
Maintain WCAG AA color contrast in both Light Mode (#FFFFFF background) and Dark Mode (#0B1220 background).
Keep WebRTC state handling, audio session management, and signaling fully functional with graceful error fallbacks.
